subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877, including same-model server_error retries before assistant failover?
rationale: The code path is a P1 bug fix, but the branch changes provider-error retry ordering and overlaps with other open candidate PRs, so automation should not choose the permanent landing path without owner intent.
